concepts.title: Virtual Memory
concepts.subtitle: Understanding the big picture
essential: Virtual memory gives each process its own address space.
Virtual addresses are translated into physical addresses.
concepts.keyIdea: Virtual memory is not the same as physical memory.
concepts.expandedExplanation: The operating system and hardware work together to translate virtual addresses into physical addresses.

quickCheck.question: What is the main purpose of virtual memory?
choices: Provide processes with a virtual address space
